node.statement: In each scalar summand C, choose the valid one-term component-diagonal representation p=1 and U=1. Substitution into each of GT-kitaev-printed-direct-sum-formula-1254 and GT-kitaev-printed-direct-sum-formula-2780-2783 gives the single term (1 direct-sum 1)^dagger tensor (1 direct-sum 1)=I_B tensor I_B. For Z=(1,0), the tensor-block coordinates of Z tensor I_B and I_B tensor Z differ (for example at block (1,2)), so the two module actions differ and def-fd-cstar-diagonal rules out this element as a diagonal.
